data.name: Chittibabu
data.gender_notes: Chittibabu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chittibabu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chitti' meaning consciousness and 'babu' meaning father. This name represents a wise and intelligent individual who is deeply connected to his inner self and values knowledge and understanding. The name Chittibabu carries the meaning “Consciousness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada. Parents who choose Chittibabu usually hope their child will grow to embody consciousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chittibabu is a name that signifies the spiritual journey of an individual towards self-realization and enlightenment. It represents the pursuit of wisdom and knowledge, and the ability to understand and connect with the inner self and the universe.
data.etymology: Chittibabu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Consciousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chittibabu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
